augments.name: Med-Mist Vents
augments.desc: Your crew heal slowly anywhere aboard.

augments.name: Damage Control Bots
augments.desc: Crew repair systems, fires and breaches 30% faster.

augments.name: Ablative Hull Layer
augments.desc: 60% fewer hull breaches and a 10% chance to shrug off system damage.

augments.name: Faraday Lining
augments.desc: 30% chance to shrug off ion damage.

augments.name: Ammo Recycler
augments.desc: 25% chance a missile or drone part is not used up.

augments.name: Adrenal Pumps
augments.desc: Crew move 20% faster and hit 10% harder.

augments.name: Emergency Barrier
augments.desc: Start every fight with a 3-point super shield.

events.text: A travelling engineering expo has set up shop in a hollowed asteroid. Every booth promises to make your ship better, faster and safer. Some of them might even be telling the truth.

choices.text: Buy the capacitor kit everyone is talking about (40 scrap).

effect.text: It hums. Your guns feel keener already.

success.text: Your crew fix a sabotaged reactor in record time and win the prize.

fail.text: Your crew come second. The consolation prize is a hat.

choices.text: Let your Enjinn crew talk shop.

effect.text: {who} leaves with three new friends and a box of free samples.
You pick up a few free brochures and a bag of bolts.
